decisions: No additive migration proposed for C-01: all data the user screen reads/writes (recommendation_runs, recommendation_items incl. estimated_minutes/weakness_tags/status, problems incl. question_no/difficulty/title/publish_status/visibility, feedback_dimension_scores) already exists in the live schema.
추천 규칙 catalog (스키마 보강 필요 label) -> UNRESOLVED via CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL: confirmed contract is result-row-centric; rule authoring is operational/admin net-new scope, escalated not applied.
Per-type entitlement lock badge -> UNRESOLVED: belongs to paywall/entitlement IA (subscriptions/subscription_plans.features), not a recommendation-data column; do not invent a problems column.
Type-filter tab state is client-only UI state; no DB change (no invented column per STABLE-QUERY rule).
